instruction: Choose a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. Before starting the work, launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to build and solve an axisymmetric circular plate model. Physical problem: A thin circular plate with a clamped outer edge is subjected to a uniform transverse pressure. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use a 2D axisymmetric model with appropriate two-dimensional plane or axisymmetric element formulation. - In the axisymmetric cross-section: - X is the radial direction. - Y is the axial/thickness direction. - The symmetry axis is X = 0. - The plate radius is 50 mm. - The plate thickness is 1 mm. - Model the rectangular cross-section: - 0 ≤ X ≤ 50 mm - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 1 mm - The clamped outer edge is X = 50 mm. - The top surface is Y = 1 mm. Model parameters: - Plate radius: 50 mm - Plate thickness: 1 mm - Material: linear elastic steel - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Element type: appropriate two-dimensional plane or axisymmetric element formulation with axisymmetric option enabled - Mesh: global element size 2 mm Boundary conditions and load: - Symmetry axis at X = 0: radial displacement UX = 0. - Clamped outer edge at X = 50 mm: radial and axial displacements are both zero, UX = 0 and UY = 0. - Apply a uniform pressure of 0.1 MPa on the top plate surface Y = 1 mm, acting in the negative Y direction. Analysis type: - Static structural analysis. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
